sections.title: Quality topics
sections.body: Current certifications and test reports are shared on request for your market and end use.
items: Shade control — Lab dips and bulk shade confirmation against Pantone, swatch, or running code.
Colourfastness — Wash, light, and rub checks aligned to the end use you name at inquiry.
Physical checks — Appearance, winding, and strength checks appropriate to the yarn type.
Documents — Test reports and certification copies shared when your market requires them.

capabilities.title: Colour matching, sampling, and supply
capabilities.description: From first shade brief to export cartons, one team owns the path so your mill or brand program stays on schedule.
capabilities.content: From first shade brief to export cartons, one team owns the path so your mill or brand program stays on schedule.

sections.title: How a dyed yarn program runs
sections.body: Sample timing depends on shade complexity; bulk starts after lab-dip approval.
items: Brief — Share fibre, denier, lustre, shade target, quantity, and destination market.
Lab dip / sample — You review shade and hand-feel before bulk is scheduled.
Bulk dyeing — Confirmed specs move to production with in-process shade checks.
Packing — Cones and cartons labeled for your receiving site.
Export — Documents prepared for your destination market.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Quote inputs, custom shades, sampling, yarn types, and reply timing.
faq.content: Short answers for mills, brands, and trading partners looking at a dyed yarn OEM.

sections.title: Buying FAQ
sections.body: We aim to respond to inquiries within one business day.
items: What do you need for a first quote? — Fibre type, denier or count range, lustre, shade target (Pantone/swatch/code), estimated quantity, and destination market.
Do you support custom shades? — Yes—lab dips and bulk shade confirmation against your reference before full production.
Can I request samples first? — Yes—request a sample on the product page or contact form before you lock a bulk schedule.
Which yarn types do you supply? — Polyester dyed yarn, space dyed yarn, twisted yarn, FDY dyed yarn, cotton dyed yarn, and nylon dyed yarn—see the product center for details.
How fast do you reply? — We aim to respond to inquiries within one business day.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Aureline Yarns handles enquiry data.
privacy.content: Aureline Yarns uses the contact details you submit to reply to quotes and project briefs. We do not sell enquiry data. To update or delete information, write to sales@aurelineyarns.com.

terms.content: Content on this website is for product information and enquiry. Specifications and lead times are confirmed in writing on each quotation. Nothing here is a binding offer. Commercial terms sit on documents issued by Aureline Yarns Co., Ltd.
